name: API Security Benchmark
description: This artifact provides a fully reproducible, Docker-based benchmark for evaluating security testing tools against the OWASP API Security Top 10 (2023). Overview: The artifact accompanies the paper "Benchmarking API Security Testing Tools Against the OWASP API Security Top 10 (2023): Coverage, Gaps, and Reproducibility". It evaluates four security testing tools (Burp Suite Professional, OWASP ZAP, JWT Tool, Nessus Professional) against two complementary testbeds: a custom Node.js API and OWASP crAPI. Contents: Custom Node.js API with 32 planted vulnerabilities covering all 10 OWASP API categories Docker Compose configuration for one-command deployment (API + MongoDB) Tool configurations for Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, JWT Tool, and Nessus Ground truth inventory with CVSS v3.1 scores and validation log Automation scripts for running all four tools 6 Jupyter notebooks reproducing all paper analyses Statistical analysis code (McNemar's test, bootstrap CIs) Figure generation scripts (radar chart, bar chart, heatmap) Raw results and computed metrics Requirements: Docker Desktop, 4 GB RAM, 10 GB disk space, Python 3.10+ (for analysis). Quick Start: docker-compose up -d ./scripts/run-all.sh jupyter lab notebooks/ Reproducibility: All results in the paper can be reproduced in approximately 1 hour. Run notebooks/06_master_integration.ipynb for a complete verification.
